Class RangeSetting

All Implemented Interfaces:
Named
public final class RangeSetting extends Setting<Range>
A pair of bounds, rendered as a two-handled slider.

The pattern this replaces is everywhere in a client: min CPS plus max CPS, min delay plus max delay, declared as two separate settings that nothing stops from crossing over. One Range keeps them ordered and gives Range.random() for the randomised value they are almost always used for.
